title: Add Contour Chart Mark

complexity.rationale: Vega has a native `contour` transform (2D kernel density estimation producing density bands directly), so no custom density-estimation algorithm needs to be designed. The underlying scatter-point layer reuses Scatter's existing symbol-mark construction as-is (aria-hidden, non-interactive). The only coordination work is layering the two and defaulting the points to non-interactive.

summary: An x/y density mark rendering KDE contour bands (Vega's native `contour` transform) with the underlying raw scatter points shown beneath, aria-hidden and non-interactive.
requirements: Computes density contour bands via Vega's built-in `contour` transform (2D KDE) — no custom density algorithm
Renders the underlying raw data points beneath the contour bands, reusing Scatter's existing point-mark construction
Underlying points are `aria-hidden` and non-interactive — they are visual context only, not a hover/tooltip target

edgeCases.case: Very few data points (e.g. fewer than 5)
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: KDE contour transform may produce sparse or empty bands with too little data — render whatever the transform outputs (including no bands) rather than special-casing a minimum count; underlying points still render.

edgeCases.case: All points at/near the same location
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Density concentrates into a small number of tight, high-value bands — no special handling needed beyond what the contour transform already computes.
Contour band fill resolves through a theme-aware sequential color scale, consistent with Heatmap's sequential color scale approach.
S1-only for this spec; no S2 port until the mark stabilizes out of rc status.
Since underlying points are non-interactive, hover/tooltip (if added to contour bands themselves in a later iteration) must not be blocked by the point layer's z-order.

crossCutting.notes: touchesTooltipOrPopover: false for this initial spec — this feature has no stated tooltip behavior on bands, and underlying points are explicitly non-interactive; a future spec could add band-level tooltips. requiresNewSignalOrScale: true — a new sequential color scale over the contour transform's computed density value domain (same scale type Heatmap needs, but a separate scale instance since they're different marks). requiresS1S2Parity: false because this ships as a new s1-only rc-status mark, matching the Donut/BigNumber precedent; revisit once promoted out of rc.

Import Contour from '../rc' and add its displayName dispatch case.
Add Contour to the sanitizeRscChartChildren import/list from '../rc'.
Update the toStrictEqual ChartOptions snapshot to include the new mark type at default values.
Basic story with a clustered-points dataset showing visible density bands.

openQuestions: What sequential color palette/token should the density scale use, and should it match or differ from Heatmap's sequential scale for visual consistency across the two marks?
Should a future iteration add hover/tooltip on contour bands themselves (showing density value), given this spec explicitly scopes that out?
